realizes.rationale: Moved from operations/implementation.md: names Worker worktree_sync and supported continuation with exact contract and resolution_action='continue' after Manager staging.

Shared refused-handover rule for Worker, Curator and Reviewer: record failed Manager notice delivery as pending, continue independent work, retry through role_message, and never turn it into a developer question in own chat.
Moved from operations/implementation.md: separates Curator content-only memory conflict repair, Manager capture/verification/staging, and Worker supported continuation.
The Worker's Tier-2 unfinished-turn rule sends what and whom it awaits to its parent via role_message.

Moved from operations/review.md (which states clean syncs open no round at line 29): retains the existing review on a clean sync while requiring the Manager to obtain the Curator's refreshed dependent-document read when clean sync changes the code or memory pair.

Moved from operations/review.md to reference/worker/sync-and-repairs.md:30-35: specifies that after a post-PASS final-check failure, the failed check and repair's focused tests run on the new tree and are recorded beside the original report rather than repeating a full run.
States that focused-test selection searches tracked tests for touched names/rules/tools/IDs and applies the same search on repairs.
Holds Worker Tier-2 sync, repair limits, post-PASS final checks, focused-test/report details, measurement/refused handovers, and stop/step-marking procedures.
